name: solana-ship-receipt
description: A signed, reviewer-readable provenance receipt for Solana projects.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm pack --dry-run --json
scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/base58.mjs && node --check src/bundle.mjs && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/receipt.mjs && node --check src/viewer.mjs
scripts.serve:local: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('sample.receipt.json')) fs.rmSync('sample.receipt.json');" && node src/cli.mjs sample --out sample.receipt.json && node src/cli.mjs serve sample.receipt.json --port 8787
scripts.serve:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('sample.receipt.json')) fs.rmSync('sample.receipt.json');" && node src/cli.mjs sample --out sample.receipt.json && node src/cli.mjs serve sample.receipt.json --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 --network --public
scripts.deploy:public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('sample.receipt.json')) fs.rmSync('sample.receipt.json');" && node src/cli.mjs sample --out sample.receipt.json && node src/cli.mjs serve sample.receipt.json --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 --network --public
